showroomPage.title: The ambition behind the showroom.
showroomPage.intro: Since {foundingYear}, {shortName} has combined buying a vehicle with personal advice — in a modern showroom with its own master workshop in {city}.
showroomPage.chapter1Text: Trust, quality and transparency aren't buzzwords here — they're the standard for every conversation. As a premium dealership, we see ourselves as your point of contact for the whole journey, from first interest to ongoing maintenance.
showroomPage.chapter2Text: Our stock of over {count} vehicles is continuously inspected, prepared and replenished — from young used cars to premium models across {specializations} and {lastSpecialization}.
showroomPage.chapter3Text: Advice starts before the first test drive: we listen, explain vehicle history and equipment in a clear way, and work out a suitable financing or leasing solution together — with no time pressure.
showroomPage.chapter4Text: Led by {management}, a {employeeCount}-strong team across sales, advice and the workshop works under one roof — for short paths and one consistent point of contact.

contactPage.title: Let's talk about your next vehicle.
contactPage.intro: Whether it's a vehicle enquiry, a test drive or advice on financing and buy-back — our team in {city} will get back to you shortly.

testDrivePage.title: Book your showroom appointment.
testDrivePage.intro: Let us know which vehicle interests you — we'll get back to you with appointment options for a personal test drive in {city}.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.notice: Notice: this website is a demo and presentation project. Company details are fictitious. This policy describes the actual technical data processing of this website and serves as a basis for a legal review before a real launch (see README, "Launch Checklist" section).
datenschutz.section2Text: When you access this website, the hosting provider automatically processes technical access data (including IP address, date and time of access, page accessed, browser used) in order to technically provide and secure the operation of the website (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). The specific hosting provider will be added here before going live.
datenschutz.section3Text: If you use the contact or test-drive form, we process the data you enter (including name, email address, phone number, message) solely to handle your enquiry (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). Data is not passed on to third parties unless necessary to process your enquiry (e.g. delivery via a technical email service provider).
datenschutz.section4Text: This website currently does not use analytics, marketing or tracking cookies. Should such services be integrated at a later date, this will only happen after prior, informed consent via a consent-management tool and an update to this policy.
datenschutz.section5Text: Links to external services (e.g. Google Maps, social networks) open the respective platform in a new tab. No external content is automatically embedded, nor is data transmitted to third parties, before you actively click such a link.
datenschutz.section6Text: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection to the processing of your personal data. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. Please contact {email} for this purpose.
datenschutz.section7Text: Data submitted via the contact form is only stored for as long as necessary to process your enquiry and to fulfil statutory retention obligations.
